text_block_list.text:
One day, shortly before the final evaluation meeting.
A dark cloud hung heavy over the conference room...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Even after we finally cleared up the misunderstanding about Tucker-san,
the tester return rate ended up being poor after all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ines and I called out to them quite a bit, but it didn't really work.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To sum up what everyone at the academy was saying—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Reapplying for the shuttle passes and the deserted island expedition
that were previously withdrawn was a bit of a hassle, so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: On top of that, it's pretty far to commute there, and I was satisfied after going just once, so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, since training can be done at Tracen Academy anyway,
there's no need to push it further.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That was pretty much the main cause of it...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Mmm! I see!
To think stepping away once would have such an impact down the line!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: It's not a place worth going out of your way to visit—to put it bluntly—wait, no!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: In any case, first comes the final evaluation meeting!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Just because things didn't go as planned
doesn't mean you can give up! Give it your absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're... totally right! Muscles don't grow unless you work them out!
If I have time to mope around, I gotta take action!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna do a bunch of time trials
at the facility we renovated yesterday!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then Chiyo and I will review the reports
we've gathered so far and compile a list.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Right then, I'll go clean up all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks, everyone!
I'm heading to the site to add the finishing touches.
—Let's stay sharp and keep at it!
And so, after making every preparation we could—the final evaluation meeting began!
